column1: # The WRN study's claims in controlled English, one row per claim (D97-era corpus).
# Each row is a result the hand-built chain states with an opaque predicate
# faithfully (style guide R1: one claim per sentence; R2: qualifiers and hedges kept). TAB-separated:
#   predicate <TAB> sentence <TAB> source <TAB> intended <TAB> outcome <TAB> skeleton
# source:   the locator in data/slices/PMC6580861.txt (the PMC author manuscript)
# intended: the proposition the sentence should mean, in readable form
# outcome:  over the full lexicon, cap-only: ENCODED / AMBIG×n / GRAMMAR-GAP / MISSING-LEXEME /
#           NON-PROSE, and for a failure the construction it lacks
# skeleton: the sense-erased skeleton of the reading that is the intended proposition, once
